name: stardew-tools-data
title: Stardew Tools data downloads (Stardew Valley 1.6.15)
description: Crop, farm animal and artisan machine tables calculated by the Stardew Tools engine from game data on the Stardew Valley Wiki. Assumptions for each column are in its description.

licenses.name: CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 (the Stardew Valley Wiki licence)

resources.name: stardew-crops
resources.title: Crops
resources.description: One row per crop: seasons, growth, sell prices by quality and profit per tile in its best season.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our slug for the crop, also its page URL: /crops/{id}/

fields.name: name
fields.description: Crop name as in the game

fields.name: type
fields.description: vegetable, fruit, flower or other

fields.name: seasons
fields.description: Seasons it grows outdoors, separated by /

fields.name: growth_days
fields.description: Days from planting to the first harvest, no fertilizer

fields.name: regrow_days
fields.description: Days between harvests for regrowing crops; empty if it is replanted

fields.name: sell_price
fields.description: Sell price of one normal-quality crop in gold, no professions

fields.name: silver_price
fields.description: Sell price at silver quality

fields.name: gold_price
fields.description: Sell price at gold quality

fields.name: iridium_price
fields.description: Sell price at iridium quality

fields.name: best_season
fields.description: Season with the highest profit per tile at Farming level 6, planted on day 1

fields.name: profit_per_tile_level0
fields.description: Gold per tile over that season at Farming level 0: harvests sold raw, minus seeds

fields.name: profit_per_tile_level6
fields.description: The same at Farming level 6

fields.name: profit_per_tile_level10
fields.description: The same at Farming level 10

fields.name: seed_cost
fields.description: Seed gold spent on one tile over that season (cheapest shop); empty if seeds have no shop price

resources.name: stardew-farm-animals
resources.title: Farm animals
resources.description: One row per farm animal: building, price, product timing, gold per day at five hearts and payback.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Our slug for the animal, also its page URL: /farm-animals/{id}/

fields.name: name
fields.description: Animal name as in the game

fields.name: building
fields.description: coop or barn

fields.name: price
fields.description: Price at Marnie's Ranch; empty if it is not sold

fields.name: days_to_mature
fields.description: Days before it starts producing

fields.name: days_between_products_base
fields.description: Days between products before friendship or professions

fields.name: days_between_products_5_hearts
fields.description: Days between products at five hearts and full mood

fields.name: raw_gold_per_day_5_hearts
fields.description: Gold a day selling its products raw at five hearts, no professions, average luck

fields.name: artisan_goods_gold_per_day_5_hearts
fields.description: Gold a day with products made into artisan goods, with the Artisan profession

fields.name: payback_days_raw
fields.description: Animal price divided by raw gold per day

fields.name: payback_days_best_case_artisan
fields.description: Animal price divided by artisan gold per day

fields.name: building_gold_from_scratch
fields.description: Gold to build the smallest building it needs from an empty plot (wood and stone not priced)

fields.name: payback_days_raw_incl_whole_building
fields.description: Days to pay back the animal and that whole building with raw sales

fields.name: payback_days_raw_incl_building_share_full
fields.description: Days to pay back the animal and its share of a full building with raw sales

resources.name: stardew-machine-rankings
resources.title: Machine rankings
resources.description: One row per crop per machine (Keg, Preserves Jar): the product, its price, the time and extra gold per machine per day.

fields.name: machine
fields.description: keg or preserves-jar

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Place in that machine's list, best extra gold per machine per day first

fields.name: crop_id
fields.description: Crop slug, as in the crops file

fields.name: product
fields.description: What the machine makes from it

fields.name: crops_needed
fields.description: Crops needed for one run (5 for Coffee, 1 for the rest)

fields.name: product_price
fields.description: Product price with the Artisan profession

fields.name: days
fields.description: Days one run takes, at 1,600 game minutes a day

fields.name: extra_gold_per_machine_day
fields.description: Product price minus the crops' raw value (with Tiller), per day of machine time
